title: Emeris Capital Gate
kicker: A great arch of pale carved stone three wagons wide, with toll-counters clacking beneath it and the green dark of Sablewood waiting beyond.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: A great arch of pale carved stone rises three wagons wide, its keystone leafed in gold and its faces worn smooth by a century of carved caravans setting out. Beneath it runs a permanent little fair: toll-counters clacking, a crier calling the morning rates, a stall hawking...

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The western threshold of Emeris, route tolls, courier departures, gate charms, caravan queues, and the first straight look into Sablewood.

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place horse-goats stamping in harness paperfin swifts nesting in arch nooks market beetles under food carts guide dogs sleeping in shade No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Emeris Crown...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Travelers buy fried dough, hot spiced cider, route tokens, painted gate charms, and advice from people who may or may not have survived the road themselves.

affordances: Look for the busiest local gathering point.
